title: Sending of the Twelve Apostles
description: Jesus called his twelve disciples to him and gave them authority over unclean spirits and to heal diseases. He named the twelve apostles and sent them out to the lost sheep of the house of Israel with the message that the kingdom of heaven has come near. He instructed them not to take gold, silver, or extra supplies for their journey, and told them how to greet the houses they entered. Jesus warned them about persecution, saying they would be brought before councils, governors, and kings, and that they would be hated for his name's sake. He urged them not to fear people but to trust in the Father's care – he who counts every hair on their head and knows when a sparrow falls. Finally, he said that whoever takes up their cross and follows him, and loses their life for his sake, will find it.
